BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, promote harmonious development of the activities of stadardization, marking and certification of goods and attending to connected matters in the country.

Revision of Indian Standards

Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of commenw. Standards are also reviewed periodically; a~standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the latest issue of `BIS Handbook' and %tandards Monthly Additions'.
